posts.cooked:
Powerhound_2000:

It was forecasted to backers of the prior campaign by Foam Brain Games but not really highlighted by GtG.

It would have only taken a quick post here by FBG. I didn't back the last one because there wasn't anything I wanted enough to warrant the expense of international shipping, and I imagine there are a lot of people on here who might want something this time round but didn't get in on the last one.

Poor marketing choice.

I like the tshirts but with literally no income it's very difficult for me to buy anything with no time to budget for it. Looks like I'll have to pass.
